messages:
maria (prod-eng): Kicking off canary for v2.3.1 to eu1 now. Quick plan: 10% traffic, run smoke suite (kvprobe + synth), wait 5m, then ramp if green.
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: rollout/v2.3.1 -> eu1-canary (10%)
kevin (eng-releases): copying checklist here: run smoke-suite.sh against canary route and watch p95 and 5xx for 5m
kevin (eng-releases): curl health endpoint if you want a quick check: `curl -sS https://eu1.api.redwood.local/healthz | jq .status`
deploy-bot: Smoke suite run 1/3: kvprobe ok, synth probe A returned 200, latency p95=138ms, errors=0
nishant (sre): seeing a small p95 blip in tracing dashboard (~220ms) at t+90s, no increased error rate. tagging @kevin
kevin (eng-releases): got it. which route? embed-route or gen-route?
nishant (sre): embed-route primarily. tail looks like transient GC on host-07, not the model.
elaine (oncall): GC confirmed on host-07 (OOM kill avoided). memory spike coincides. I've isolated host from canary pool to be safe.
maria (prod-eng): Nice catch, thanks. Can we replay the synth probe against remaining canary hosts?
kevin (eng-releases): doing a targeted synth run now against eu1-canary excluding host-07.
kevin (eng-releases): synth run 2/3: p95=132ms, errors=0. TTLs look normal.
deploy-bot: Telemetry summary (v2.3.1 canary, t+4m): synth p95 avg=135ms, 5xx=0, token throughput stable.
maria (prod-eng): Given GC and isolated host, recommend proceed with ramp to 50% in 10m. Any objections?
nishant (sre): hold one more synth at t+6m, then I'm fine with 50% if it stays stable.
elaine (oncall): agreed, hold for one more run. I'm watching traces.
kevin (eng-releases): running final synth (3/3). output:
```
SYNTH CHECK [eu1-canary] - probe-id=6082
- route: /v1/embed
- p95: 139ms
- 5xx: 0
- sample_count: 120
- samples_ok: 120/120
```
kevin (eng-releases): looks clean.
maria (prod-eng): ok ramping to 50% in 2m. I'll update release notes and update the rollout tag.
deploy-bot: Rollout updated: eu1-canary -> 50% traffic for v2.3.1
kevin (eng-releases): updated rollout tag and release-notes snippet: "v2.3.1: embed perf fixes, quant-aware kernel selection"
nishant (sre): monitor p95 across quant variants; if p95 > 200ms for 2 consecutive minutes, auto-pin to stable and rollback traffic to 10%
maria (prod-eng): added temporary pin policy: fallback -> v2.2.9 if errors > 0.5% or p95 > 220ms sustained 2m
elaine (oncall): I'll keep an eye during the 50% ramp. If anything odd, I'll call a pin.
kevin (eng-releases): FYI I've recorded the synth outputs and uploaded to deploy artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/rollouts/4398765432/v2.3.1/smoke.tar.gz
maria (prod-eng): thanks. if we stay green for 15m we'll finish the rollout. :thumbsup:
elaine (oncall): thumbs. I also set an alert on the embed p95 spike for 180ms so we get early warning.
deploy-bot: Rollout progress check t+12m: traffic=50%, synth p95=137ms, 5xx=0, alarms=none
maria (prod-eng): closing thread, continuing monitoring in channel. final note for release notes: include host GC fix note and canary metrics.
kevin (eng-releases): noted, will include perf table in the release blog.
